newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: LWR withdraws from talks on Canterbury.
newsitem.headline: LWR withdraws from talks on Canterbury.

text.p: Textile manufacturer LWR Industries Ltd said on Friday it had withdrawn from talks on a joint venture for its Canterbury brand.
In the financial year to June 30, the Canterbury group of companies within the LWR Group continue to achieve growth and are forecast to meet financial budgets, LWR said.
In December 1996, LWR signalled it was undertaking a search for an appropriate investment partner for Canterbury, a manufacturer of rubgy jerseys and sportswear.

The prime objective was to seek a partner that had international experience in brand management and the ability to open up distribution opportunities, particularly in the Northern Hemisphere, LWR said.

"While there have been a number of international parties expressing interest in this proposal, the directors have concluded that these parties do not fulfil the specific criteria initially, which was principally to add further value."
